name: Suteki Desu wa, Sakura-chan! Tomoyo no Cardcaptor Sakura Katsuyaku Video Nikki!
name_english: You're Wonderful, Sakura-chan! Tomoyo's Cardcaptor Sakura Video Diary!
name_romanji: You're Wonderful, Sakura-chan! Tomoyo's Cardcaptor Sakura Video Diary!
original_title: すてきですわ、さくらちゃん！ 知世のカードキャプターさくら活躍ビデオ日記！
description: The first OVA of the anime series of Cardcaptor Sakura. This is a video of Tomoyo Daidouji previewing the making of the first opening video of Cardcaptor Sakura (the Catch You Catch Me video).
